description: Use this when you need a GAIP receipt in another format. Pass `receipt_id` and `format`: x402 (attestation style), erc8004 (validation-response shape) or vc (W3C-VC-like JSON-LD). Ed25519-signed when the runtime key is available; hash chain and Merkle proof; no on-chain write. Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

receipt_id.description: The receipt_id exactly as an earlier GAIP result returned it. Have none? Call with any id: the refusal lists example_receipt_ids from GAIP's own public records.

name: gaip_receipt_export
title: Export a GAIP receipt
